name: Dahi Bhallay
description: Pakistani dahi bhallay with soft mash-daal dumplings, chilled seasoned yogurt, sweet-sour tamarind chutney, mint chutney and chaat spices.
ingredients: 1 tsp chaat masala, or to taste
method: Drain the soaked mash daal and grind it into a thick, smooth batter, adding only as much water as needed for the blender or grinder to work.
Beat the batter briefly to lighten it, then heat the frying oil and fry small spoonfuls in manageable batches until cooked through and evenly golden.
Transfer the fried bhallay to warm water and let them soften. Remove them carefully and press very gently between your palms to release excess water without crushing them.
Whisk the chilled yogurt until smooth and season lightly with salt and some roasted cumin if desired.
Arrange the softened bhallay in a serving dish and cover them generously with the seasoned yogurt.
Drizzle with tamarind and mint chutneys, then finish with chaat masala and roasted cumin. Chill briefly or serve once the bhallay have absorbed some yogurt.
